steps.say: Takayasu arteritis is a chronic granulomatous inflammation of the whole aortic wall and its main branches. Subclavian, carotid, and renal arteries are involved with the pulmonary arteries. Young females under 40 years of age are affected characteristically. Big vessels are inflaming in young women.

steps.say: The 2022 ACR and EULAR criteria are requiring onset at 60 years or below with imaged large vessel vasculitis as entry. Five or more points are accumulated across clinical and imaging domains. Pulse deficit with claudication, bruits, and pressure gaps above 20 are scoring clinically. Narrowing with occlusion and wall thickening are scoring on imaging. Young onset with imaged damage is classifying.

steps.say: Hata angiography is sorting Takayasu into six anatomical patterns. Arch branches alone are forming the first type. Ascending arch disease with or without descending thoracic involvement is forming the next two. Thoracoabdominal disease with renal arteries is following. Abdominal disease with renal arteries alone is standing apart. Combined extensive disease is closing the list as the commonest. Maps are running from arch to abdomen.

steps.say: Renal artery narrowing is hitting 30 to 50 percent of Takayasu patients. Ostial or proximal lesions are firing the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system. Severe renovascular hypertension is following the ischemia. Cuffs on pulseless claudicating arms are hiding the pressure. Kidney ischemia is raising pressure silently.

steps.say: Cardiac complications are deciding survival in Takayasu arteritis. Inflammatory root dilatation is bringing severe aortic regurgitation in up to 25 percent. Ascending aortitis is narrowing the coronary ostia. Heart failure is following the valve and vessel damage. Branch pulmonary vasculitis is breeding pulmonary hypertension. Roots are leaking while ostia are narrowing.

steps.say: Non-invasive imaging is replacing catheter angiography for diagnosis and follow-up. MR angiography with CT angiography and 18F-FDG PET-CT are mapping the walls. Early mural edema is showing concentric thickening with delayed enhancement. Fixed luminal stenosis is arriving later in the course. Walls are swelling before lumens are narrowing.

steps.say: High-dose prednisone at 1 mg per kg daily is inducing remission at the start. Relapses are striking 50 to 70 percent during steroid tapering. Early steroid-sparing drugs are sustaining the response. Methotrexate with azathioprine, leflunomide, or mycophenolate mofetil is carrying the taper. Steroids are inducing while sparers are sustaining.

steps.say: Relapsing or refractory disease is yielding to biologic therapy. Anti-TNF monoclonals infliximab and adalimumab are freezing lesion progression. Interleukin-6 blockade with tocilizumab is sparing steroids equally. Surgical or endovascular revascularization is waiting strictly for quiescent disease. Biologics are freezing lesions while knives are waiting for quiet.
